title: A directed computed scout orders candidate minima across the three full-Fisher slabs

computed_pilot.method: seeded differential evolution on compact-window double quadrature; computed evidence only
computed_pilot.route_effect: Prioritize outward gradient signs and value lower bounds on slabs one and two; prioritize interval Newton around the slab-three locator.

scope_guard: The pilot uses floating quadrature and optimization. It chooses the next certificate route but is not citable as a lower bound, an exhaustive search, stationarity, slab exclusion or global ordering.
